notes.title: 20250518 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.Fixed an issue with incorrect water levels
2.Optimized UI content and display
3.Improved jump responsiveness
4.Enhanced room layout and guidance

notes.title: 20250516 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed collision issues with marbles (preventing clipping).
Improved level guidance in specific stages.

notes.title: 20250509 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue where marble could get stuck outside tube.  
2. Fixed incorrect sound effects for marbles.  
3. Added the ability to jump while on ladders.  
4. Added a low-stamina warning alert.  
5. Optimized menu UI interaction logic.  
6. Increased stamina consumption when jumping in water.  
7. Added mouse cursor display in small-screen mode.  
8. Improved color contrast between certain backgrounds and foregrounds.  
9. Resolved soft-lock issues in some level designs.  
10. Added an automatic prompt when the playtest ends.

notes.title: 20250506 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.Fixed an issue where key bindings could not be set in certain scenes.
2.Resolved conflicts when binding multiple keys simultaneously.
3.Added English translations for key binding settings.

notes.title: 20250501 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.Fixed UI interaction logic errors.
2.Updated content on the start screen.
3.Added windowed mode option in the settings menu.
4.Fixed incorrect English voice-over in the opening cinematic.

notes.title: Minor Patch Update
notes.notes: Updated a small number of patches based on feedback.
